entities.summary: Maya Parbhoe is a Surinamese businesswoman and politician who is a candidate for the 2025 presidential elections of Suriname. Since December 2024 she is a member of the National Party of Suriname. She is CEO of Daedalus Labs and board member of Icarus Geo.
